tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page ground on every surface. From velio.app.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, sheets and the spots badge sitting on cream.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards; neutral chip fill. Decorative only, never a control boundary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on cream (17.8:1) and surface (19.8:1). Sold-out badge fill.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on cream (8.0:1) and surface (8.9:1). Replaces the site's #818181, which fails at 3.5:1.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand ink: headings, CTA text on lime (11.3:1), chip text, secondary button border, focus ring (12.1:1 on cream). From velio.app.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill, spots-changed flash, claimed and vouch chips. Never text or a sole boundary on cream (1.07:1). From velio.app.

tokens.name: lime-press
tokens.usage: Pressed and loading primary CTA. From velio.app.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The live dot in the spots badge and connection pill. A mark, never text (4.0:1 on surface, passes 3:1 for marks).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions and error field borders on surface (6.3:1) and cream (5.6:1). Always paired with words.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Disclosure and information panels; ink and forest text on it.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button and stale badge fill; muted text on it (7.4:1).

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Text field border on surface (3.5:1, passes 3:1 for control boundaries).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Opened and public-link chips; avatar colour 2. Forest text on it (10.3:1).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Avatar colour 3; last-spots warning tint. Forest text on it.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Avatar colour 4. Forest text on it.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Avatar colour 5. Forest text on it.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map ground in representative map art (designs only; production maps are Google's).

tokens.name: map-water

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Parks and reserves in representative map art.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Roads in representative map art.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display
